# elizaOS News
> Daily AI-generated intelligence briefings for the elizaOS ecosystem

## About
elizaOS News (elizaos.news) publishes daily intelligence briefings covering Discord activity, X/Twitter news, GitHub development, market analysis, strategic insights, and AI Council deliberations for the elizaOS project.

## Feeds
- Daily Intelligence RSS: https://elizaos.news/rss/feed.xml
- Council Briefings RSS: https://elizaos.news/rss/council.xml

## Data Endpoints
- Latest dates: https://elizaos.news/api/data/latest.json
- Full catalog: https://elizaos.news/api/data/manifest.json

## URL Patterns
- Daily briefing: https://elizaos.news/daily/{YYYY-MM-DD}
- Council briefing: https://elizaos.news/council/{YYYY-MM-DD}
- Daily poster images: https://elizaos.news/media/daily/{YYYY-MM-DD}/overall.png

## Sitemap
- https://elizaos.news/sitemap-index.xml

## Documentation
- API reference: https://elizaos.news/api
- Source code: https://github.com/M3-org/ai-news-website
